flipToBack.prose: Flips when your matching operatives CONTROL at least 3 battleground sites related to the Renegade planet (controlsWith: you control the site AND at least one of your matchingOperativeToRenegadePlanet is there; spot override includes excluded-from-battle).

children.req: controlsWith: control 3 locations with actor there
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.controlsWith(game, self, playerId, 3, Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.Renegade_planet_location), SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.matchingOperativeToRenegadePlanet))

flipToFront.prose: Flips back when you do NOT OCCUPY at least 2 battleground sites related to the Renegade planet (plain occupies, no operative requirement).

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: CONTROL (controlsWith) 3 Renegade-planet battleground sites, each with at least one of YOUR matching operatives there; control-with, not mere occupy
flipToFront: NOT OCCUPY 2 Renegade-planet battleground sites; plain occupy (any of your cards), operatives NOT required to hold the back
asymmetry: flip needs operatives at controlled sites; staying flipped only needs occupation by anything of yours
The Renegade planet is runtime state selected during Objective setup via gameState.setRenegadePlanet(systemName) (Card7_298.java:53-56).
typedIdentities: Filters.planet_system (setup: choose Renegade planet; sets gameState.setRenegadePlanet(systemName))
Filters.and(Filters.generic, Filters.site) (setup site + per-deploy-phase download, both to Renegade planet system)
Filters.site (independent Dantooine Operative download to Dantooine while that operative is at a Dantooine site)
Filters.Rebel (back: power +2 when operative at same site as a Rebel)
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup order 1 (Objective, required): deploy any planet system from Reserve Deck for free and without reshuffling; its system name becomes the Renegade planet [Card7_298.java:46-56; DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect.java:41-45].

Setup order 2 (nested in the selected system's cardDeployed callback): deploy one generic site to that system for free and without reshuffling [Card7_298.java:58-64; DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect.java:31-35].

Later Objective source, once during each owner deploy phase: deploy one generic site to the Renegade planet; this overload is not flagged free and reshuffles [Card7_298.java:83-98; DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect.java:21-23].

Tested operative source, independently once during each owner deploy phase: Dantooine Operative at a Dantooine site may deploy one site (Filters.site, not generic-only) to Dantooine and reshuffle [Card7_174.java:64-81]. No source order exists between this action and the Objective action.
otherObligations: Back modifier: opponent's Force drains are -1 everywhere (ForceDrainModifier(self, Filters.any, -1, opponent)) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set7/dark/Card7_298_BACK.java:66]

Back: may retrieve 1 Force whenever you deploy a matching operative to the Renegade planet (optional trigger) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set7/dark/Card7_298_BACK.java:74-93]

Back modifiers: your matching operatives on Renegade planet are forfeit +2; power +2 when at same site as a Rebel [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set7/dark/Card7_298_BACK.java:67-69]

Back: once per battle, when your matching operative in battle on Renegade planet, may add one battle destiny [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set7/dark/Card7_298_BACK.java:103-116]

profile.frontStructuredRule: preFlip/flip allOf: self controlsWith >=3 Renegade_planet_battleground_site using matchingOperativeToRenegadePlanet
profile.runtimeGeography: The selected Renegade planet is read from gameState. Candidate sites are projected through the exact source-card deploy filter at that planet.
profile.formationLaw: Each counted site needs a matching operative plus another legal source of presence or ability because the operative's own ability is excluded from control on its matching planet.

behaviorProof.setup: Dark public Rando and Chosen One both choose Dantooine (three matching operatives) over Tatooine (zero), then choose a source-projected legal battleground site.
behaviorProof.pull: Dark public decisions use Imperial Occupation and Dantooine Operative once each, in either order, to reach three usable route sites through their real child selections. The deterministic Objective-first case proves the operative action survives a stale source-text parser false negative. The shared back-side route lets only an eligible operative add a third hold-buffer site.
behaviorProof.deploy: Dark public decisions deploy three one-Force Dantooine Operatives and three one-Force Stormtroopers with exactly six Force, distribute three complete formations, and trigger unchanged 7_298 card Java's native flip. The planner requires exact engine deployability, actual modified payments, and safe weapon-adjusted contact.
behaviorProof.crossPhase: Dark movement, battle, loss, forfeit, casualty, contested post-flip blocker, and back-side buffer-pull branches are shared with the Light-side fixtures and mirrored between both bot implementations rather than duplicated solely for side symmetry.
behaviorProof.sourceProjection: The Dark public setup choice uses the source's free deploy-to-system projection. Later Objective and operative pulls use their exact paid filters and require a projected battleground destination, while the operative source itself may stand at any matching-planet site.
behaviorProof.parity: Every Dark public setup, pull, and deploy decision is compared between Rando and Chosen One. All five paired production files match after package normalization.
behaviorProof.verification: The focused family, engine, policy, and deploy-script gate passes 77 tests. The bounded neighboring regression gate passes 179 tests, for 256 current tests with zero failures. JSON validation and normalized mirror checks pass; package proof is recorded separately when run.
